name: MOMO Mizrahi
source: She is a 100-Series prototype Realian designed to observe and contact the Gnosis, beings that can only be detected by a "special sense." She was created by Joachim Mizrahi, and she resembles his deceased daughter, Sakura Mizrahi. Her outward appearance is that of a 12 year old.
